subject: Incremental presence bands for LuminaHealth workshop - calendar holds
messages:
From: Emily Price <e.price@luminahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@luminahealth.com>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@luminahealth.jp>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Incremental presence bands for Nov workshop - initial ask

Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick call earlier. We're trying to finalize our multi-day, multi-region format for the Nov 30 - Dec 2 workshop and want to confirm the calendar holds before travel is booked. Key asks from our side: 

- Day 0 (Nov 29): Optional in-person arrival / pre-onboarding for EMEA attendees only (approx 20 people). Can Redwood provide an on-site contact and AV check on that day?
- Day 1 (Nov 30): Hybrid all-hands (EMEA in-person + US virtual staggered attendance). We need two distinct presence bands: 09:00-13:00 CET in-person, 14:30-18:30 CET virtual overlap for US participants.
- Day 2 (Dec 1): Focused workshops by product track; some tracks will be fully in-person, others virtual. We will send a headcount by Nov 17 but need calendar holds to block rooms and flights.

Also attaching our latest headcount spreadsheet for your planning. Can you confirm recommended venue access windows and whether Redwood can support a short on-site AV run on Nov 29 evening?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Price
Director, Digital Programs — LuminaHealth

Subject: Re: Incremental presence bands for Nov workshop - initial ask

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the clarity and the headcount file. High level notes and what we can do: 

- Day 0 (Nov 29): Yes, we can provide an on-site Redwood contact and do an evening AV smoke test. We'll plan for a 16:00-18:00 window for tech checks.
- Day 1 (Nov 30): Your proposed presence bands work. We'll create two calendar holds (EMEA in-person band and a US-overlap virtual band) with explicit timezone labels to avoid confusion.
- Day 2 (Dec 1): Once you lock the track headcounts we'll map rooms to tracks and flag any AV-heavy sessions.

Action items I can own now:
1) Draft calendar-hold ICS files for the three days and share for your review (will include local timezone labels).
2) Confirm Redwood on-site contact and AV tech team availability for Nov 29 evening.
3) Coordinate travel guidance for internal Redwood attendees that need to be on-site for Day 0.

Marissa — can you prepare a short AV-runbook and confirm if we need to ship any adapters to the venue? Monica — can you advise on travel-liaison capacity for late November?

I'll follow up with the calendar-hold ICS and a proposed schedule by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

On Wed, Nov 10, 2026 at 11:04 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa — can you prepare a short AV-runbook and confirm if we need to ship any adapters to the venue?

Thanks — looping in AV ops. Quick runbook summary below and attached full runbook.

- Nov 29 (16:00-18:00): AV smoke test (projector, room mic, zoom bridge, HDMI/USB-C adapters). Recommend we ship 6x USB-C to HDMI adapters and 2x spare HDMI cables.
- Day 1 (Nov 30): Primary room (main stage) needs 2x lapel mics, 1x lectern mic, and the Zoom bridge with dedicated uplink. Secondary rooms: single presenter mics and room capture.
- Day 2 (Dec 1): Track rooms will be standard; AV only for tracks flagged as 'demo-heavy'. Please flag demos by Nov 17.

Logistics ask: venue door access typically requires a list of names 48 hours in advance. Emily — can you confirm the onsite list and whether Lumina will provide guest badges or should Redwood manage day passes?

Attaching runbook: Day0_AV_Runbook.pdf

Marissa Cole
Events & Field Ops — Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is great. Confirmations: 

- Lumina will provide guest badges and a door list 72 hours prior (will send on Nov 26).
- Headcount v2 looks accurate for our initial planning; we'll send final by Nov 17.
- We accept the Nov 29 16:00-18:00 AV check.

Marcus — please proceed with the calendar holds and ICS files. We prefer separate invites per presence band (so attendees only accept the slot relevant to them). Also, can Redwood publish the designated local contact (name + mobile) in the invites?

Thanks,
Emily
